name: Language-mixed sample into a feature card grid
looks: A two-colour headline names who the product is built for. Below it one example line shows two languages or scripts mixed naturally in the same sentence, captioned. It cuts to a small 2x2 grid of short feature cards (edit any word, word-by-word timing, export resolution, subtitle file formats), each with a one-line label and a small sample.
build: list-stack-reveal for the headline and the single mixed-language example line, which gets its own karaoke-caption-sync pass to prove the highlight works across both scripts. variant-stack-reveal for the 2x2 feature grid, each card settling with a tiny seeded offset.
sound: A tick per stacked line, then a soft cluster of pops as the four feature cards land.
prompt: Prove the product fits a specific audience: show one real example line that naturally mixes two languages or scripts, correctly captioned, then back it with a small grid of concrete feature cards (editing, timing, export, formats) that matter to that audience specifically.
